mapper.select: select sw.*, so.sku_sale_attribute as skuName, so.order_sku_info ->> '$.spuName' as spuName, so.order_sku_info ->> '$.spuImg' as spuImg from settle_order_wait sw left join sku_order so on sw.sku_order_id = so.id where sw.settle_time_node < #{settleTimeNode} and sw.settle_time_node > 1 and sw.settle_state = 0 and sw.del_flag = 0
